idle.action: One restrained natural breathing cycle: settled stance, slight chest inhale with shoulders subtly raised, gently settling exhale, return near first pose. Keep both feet planted at the same baseline, helmet a rigid unchanged shape, hands empty and steady. No blink, squash-stretch, walk, sway, cape or equipment. Four individually drawn consistent full-body poses.

style: Hand-drawn dark-fairytale cartoon, bold uneven ink outlines, two or three broad painted tones per material. NOT pixel art, no realistic texture or PBR.
